name: Yadorimushi ~Boku ga Shokushu de Shokushu ga Boku de~
original_name: 宿り蟲 ～僕が触手で触手が僕で～
source:
Quiet main character has always been a target of bullying. One day he picks up a tentacle seed fallen from the sky. Next day he is visited by devil girl Lilim who makes a mistake so that tentacle merges with protagonist. The only way to get rid of the tentacle now is to attack women to create enough energy for a new seed to emerge...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沉默寡言的主人公一直饱受欺凌。一天，他捡到了一颗从天而降的触手种子。第二天，恶魔少女莉莉姆来访，由于一个失误，触手与主人公融合了。如今摆脱触手的唯一方法就是侵犯女性，产生足够的能量让新的种子诞生……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
